45 HR. 38 SB. Two stolen bases from the rarest club in baseball.

Pete Crow-Armstrong is chasing a 40-40 season — no Cub has ever done it, and only six players in MLB history have.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

research.facts:
PCA 40-40 Chase
**Key Facts:**
- Current line: 45 HR / 38 SB (after Sept 20 game vs Reds)
- Needs: 2 more stolen bases for 40-40
- Games left: 6 (through end of regular season)
- Historical significance:
- Would be 7th 40-40 season in MLB history
- Would be first Cub ever to accomplish 40-40
- Notable prior 40-40 players: Jose Canseco (1988), Barry Bonds (1996), Alex Rodriguez (1998), Alfonso Soriano (2006), plus more recent names — per Fox Sports framing
- Last 40-40: Shohei Ohtani (2024, 54 HR / 59 SB)
- Recent game: PCA hit his 45th HR on Sept 20 — 105.3 exit velocity, 411 ft to right-center
- Extra context: PCA also passed Billy Williams for most HR in a season by a LH Cub (Williams set record at 42 HR in 1970) — LOW confidence for citation, do not use in tweet without verification
**Compound claim check**: "first Cub ever, 7th MLB player" — requires two-source verification before using as HIGH confidence. Story history cites "Only 6 players in MLB history have done it; no Cub ever." Fox Sports refers to "the much rarer 40/40." MEDIUM confidence — usable but flag in fact-check.
**Sources:**
- Cubs story-history.md Sept 21 (MEDIUM — single pipeline origin)
- Hoodline: hoodline.com/2026/09/cubs-star-pete-crow-armstrong-nears-rare-40-40-feat-after-record-breaking-night/ (MEDIUM)
- Fox Sports: foxsports.com/stories/mlb/chicago-cubs-pete-crow-armstrong-40-home-runs-40-steals (MEDIUM)

research.facts:
WC1 Seeding — Wrigley Home Field
**Key Facts:**

- Cubs went 6-1 vs. Philadelphia Phillies in the 2026 regular season
- Tiebreaker implication: If Cubs and Phillies finish tied, Cubs own WC1 = home field for entire Wild Card Series
- Wild Card Series is best-of-3 — all games at WC1 team's park if Cubs hold seed
- Diamondbacks: ~4 GB, 6 games left — not a realistic threat to overtake Cubs
